name: Ghillie Archie

intro.text: Tread softly in these pines. The big grouse are lekking, and the cocks have no manners. One chased me up a gatepost last April.

win: Good fight. Walk away slowly, don't turn your back, and nobody gets pecked.
after: A lek is where the males gather to show off. It is, in short, a nightclub for grouse.
